entries.claim_boundary: Publication-independent Phase-1 structural crosswalk only. Einstein inclusion is not symplectic equivalence; total charge cancellation is not separate neutrality; smooth secular solvability is not bounded or causal solvability; no particle or quantum claim is made.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The complete bounded common zero remains open; the exact blockwise criterion is certified.

causal_retarded.statement: No causal/retarded correction carrier is imported by this synthesis.

smooth_secular.statement: The finite exponential-polynomial five-covector criterion is theorem-frozen.

scope.boundaries: closed S1_L x S2 before final stabilizer reduction
scope.charge_sector: fixed N=2 and Q_e; total charge cancellation kept distinct from separate neutrality
scope.ell: generic >=2; lower strata only where separately certified
scope.k: all certified compact momenta; third-order fixture k=0
scope.omega: q/p primary shells; third-order fixture four occupied original shells
